# Generation Requirements Checklist: Standalone Canvas Generator Extension

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, and consistency of the end-to-end generation and override protocol requirements.
**Created**: 2026-09-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the human choices, Specify-supplied composition, derived target, and overwrite decision assigned to explicit sources of authority for both Wizard and CLI requests? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the request's required fields, version, immutable boundary, and handling of missing or unknown fields documented together? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the prerequisites and minimum supported Specify capabilities defined without assuming an unreleased composition-domain resolver? [Completeness, Assumption, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the authoring host, same-turn validated brief, `create-canvas` scaffold, and unavailable-capability outcomes specified for the default generation path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the six default experience categories and the valid empty command-derived override documented so generation needs no optional design provider? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the complete candidate's required blueprint, experience, protected runtime, renderer, assets, and receipt defined before publication? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-019]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the point at which a fresh composition replaces a stale preview precise, including whether later provider changes can affect an in-flight request? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the ordered selected phase IDs and exact effective provider stacks unambiguously distinguished from agent-provided phase descriptions or reconstructed precedence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the default sparse draft `{"categories": {}}`, finalized override fields, request digest authority, and required finalization sequence explicitly distinguished? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the ownership and allowable paths of command-derived values versus complete customer-owned category replacements clear, including suppression behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it explicit that a missing, draft-only, or request-mismatched finalized override is invalid rather than a reason to use defaults? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the unsupported topology and missing-provider conditions sufficiently specific to distinguish rejected workflows from supported linear ones? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Do the Wizard and standalone CLI requirements prescribe equivalent authoritative requests and results without giving either path a separate composition precedence policy? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the immutable request, finalized override, compiled blueprint, and receipt consistently bound to the same generation run across the specification and generation contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK015 Do default-generation requirements preserve mandatory finalized-override validation while allowing an empty sparse draft? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK016 Do design-package eligibility checks leave Specify's effective stack unchanged while prohibiting tagged contributors to selected runtime phases for both entry paths? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK017 Are publication and inspection requirements consistent with the rule that an absent controlled result is an interruption, not a success? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-020]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Can default generation's complete five-phase journey be assessed against the stated uninterrupted-workflow criterion without adding an unstated time limit? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the comparison inputs and observable outputs defined well enough to judge Wizard/CLI equivalence objectively? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK020 Is standalone operation in a compatible recipient repository defined clearly enough to judge default-generation success without the Wizard or generation session? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK021 Are controlled failure and interrupted-run success indicators distinguishable enough to assess actionable-failure outcomes? [Measurability, Spec §FR-020, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Are primary first-time generation and alternate standalone CLI generation each specified from choice collection through opening the generated canvas? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK023 Are invalid snapshot data, incompatible CLI, missing phase binding, tagged runtime contributors, and unsupported authoring host accounted for before a request or target is written? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK024 Are invalid draft fields, protected values, unknown category keys, null deletion, and mismatched request digests addressed without silent fallback? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK025 Are unsafe target paths, symlinks or reparse points, out-of-bounds assets, and invalid renderer capabilities addressed before final-target mutation? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK026 Are partial publication, failed reload or inspection, missing outcome, and ordinary Regenerate recovery defined without implying backup or broad-directory deletion? [Recovery, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK027 Are existing-target confirmation, cancellation, and the scope of all-files deletion unambiguous for both Generate and Regenerate? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-022]

## Non-Functional Requirements and Dependencies

- [ ] CHK028 Are confinement, exact-request staging, bounded cleanup, and exclusion of reusable secrets stated for generation controls and receipts? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK029 Are deterministic contract semantics distinguished from non-byte-identical scaffold-authored source across otherwise equivalent runs? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-003, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK030 Are the PR #32 extraction baseline and tested Specify release identified as prerequisites to parity and compatibility claims rather than assumed completed work? [Dependency, Assumption, Spec §FR-004]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add findings inline and link to relevant requirements or contracts as needed.
